Guide indicates when to escalate or report a bug

Guide covers strategy execution failures (subprocess errors, log generation issues)

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Strategy Execution Errors: Capture all exceptions, log to session/errors.log, mark session as FAILED. Log Parsing Errors: Validate schema, reject malformed logs. Comparison Errors: Handle missing data gracefully.

doc.title: PRD
doc.snippet: NFR4: Log parsing robust to minor format variations. NFR7: Recover from test failures without corrupting session. NFR9: Validate all inputs. NFR10: Prevent data loss during investigation workflows.

file.reason: Session state management and error handling

constraints.constraint: Strategy Execution Errors: Capture all exceptions, log to session/errors.log, mark session as FAILED
Log Parsing Errors: Validate log schema on parse, reject malformed logs with clear error message
Comparison Errors: Handle missing data gracefully, report as findings not exceptions
Log parsing must be robust to minor format variations (NFR4)
System must recover from test failures without corrupting session state (NFR7)
System must validate all inputs before processing (NFR9)
System must prevent data loss during investigation workflows (NFR10)
Organize by symptom (what user sees) not by cause

tests.standards: Organized by symptom. Include error message text for searchability. Provide diagnostic commands. Keep updated as new issues are discovered.
